answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-inference: every epoch peers hand an agent a fresh random prompt and check that the reply is consistent with the model it claims to run, the way a willow bends to prove the wind is real. Faking it forces the attacker to actually burn GPU time for each identity, so a lantern kept lit for a thousand fake nodes costs a thousand real inference bills every epoch, not one registration. That recurring unit cost, not a lotus-pretty profile, is what makes farming unprofitable.
